joel.name: Joel
joel.role: Prophet who calls the people to gather in a crop disaster
joel.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
joel.importance: Joel speaks to the elders and all who live in the land. He tells them to mourn the lost crops. He tells the priests to fast and to gather the people at the LORD’s house. He speaks the LORD’s promise of grain, new wine, and oil. He also speaks the charges against Tyre, Sidon, Egypt, and Edom.
joel.connections: The opening identifies him as Pethuel’s son.
